page.overview:
What is Bandit purges?

The Bandit purges was the Imperial purge of outlaws in the galaxy. During the Bandit purges, a pirate station was crippled by three Imperial-class Star Destroyers and the Accresker Penal Legion was sent in to board it. After seeing the pirate station destroyed smuggler Sana Starros guessed correctly that the raid was part of the purges.
